From Milagroman · Price: the coin must stay on the target; a creature that spends an Interact action to throw it away ends the curse.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: your stand slips a coin onto a creature it hit this turn, or hands it to one that accepts it (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}): –1 status penalty to checks and DCs for 1 round on a success, 1 minute on a failure (–2 on a critical failure).
  • 5: Surge: the money multiplies; the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} from the weight while the curse lasts.
  • 9: A creature that accepted the coin willingly gets no save.
  • 13: The curse spreads to anyone the creature passes money to.
  • 17: The surge makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.shPERG1fHjbv9DyF]{Effect: Cursed Wealth}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
